build_feature_selection_pipeline: build a scikit-learn pipeline with SelectKBest and LinearSVC for univariate feature selection and classification
create_SelectKBest_selector: create a SelectKBest selector with f_classif to rank and select the top k most significant features
test_f_classif_scoring: test the f_classif function to compute F-test scores and p-values for univariate feature scoring
